book.name: Galesia
book.title: Galesia Quraŋ Polji Galesia yoŋore Quraŋ ruaya.

content: Yobiŋ-ŋaŋuŋ osigaru babapi eku goinebi.

O maŋkekerisie ogopune, moji kadi odureru agiburaŋ eko bofukegobi ine, maŋkekerisie ogopune ŋoŋoji ogo oŋuine oi bomiriŋ eteru botiŋ gatebi moke kadi bofukeiŋ. Oŋu eru gake oŋuakoŋ eesoigo egu waki guiŋgo ore sisiŋaŋ eku goigoŋ.
Yobiŋ-ŋaŋuŋ babapi eku osigaeinebi. Oŋuine oo Kristore Kadi buŋo boyobebi foriineke fukeeiŋ.
Moji wakiqoqoine goku jibu iŋoyoŋere maneko ropekiine fukega, iŋoji iŋoyoŋe eadu eega.

Oŋu so einebiyoŋ, moakoŋ moakoŋ ŋoŋoji ŋoŋo-ŋaŋunde eebobo osoeru baesoi babi sagaiŋ. Oŋu eru ogoŋaŋuŋ odureru biŋeroroyaŋuŋke fukegobi ore so sakipepe einebiyoŋ, ŋoŋo-ŋaŋunde fuŋinere sakiŋaŋuŋ miteŋ gabi sagaiŋ.
Anutuji yobiŋnoŋuŋ furuine furuine boroiŋgaru noreko bubu osigaegobeneŋ. Ore eru noŋuŋ goine yoŋoke mobemobe eru osoe eku gokimiŋgo embimbiŋgaegobeneŋ.
Qaqaji more Biŋe buŋo qaji teega, iŋoji ore furiine bokirieru yaine fiine sosowo boroiŋgaru mobeine oteeine.

Ŋoŋo-ŋaŋe so eadu eku goinebi. Moji uqo wikiine sariko foriine ore so fukeko bofukeiŋ. Buŋo ore so Anutuji seinenoŋuŋ ŋoneru geoine ore so noreiŋ. Ore eru Anutu oi ŋi omaine oŋuine igosisi etekimiŋgo embimbiŋgaegobeneŋ.

Maŋ sakire aŋi sanaŋine sembeneji mo maŋgo eteko ore wikiine kosa sariega, iŋoji ore ketoqototieine bofukeru sembeaeiŋ. Iŋoji sembeaeiŋyoŋ, Moro Tiriineji mo boburo teme ore wikiine sariega, iŋoji foriine ore so bofukeru gogo sanaŋinere biŋe fukeru goiŋ.
Noŋuŋ miine dimaku gio fiine fiine baku goku oo wirieru roroka so eiŋinebi. Qoqouma eru gio so bokekimiŋ ine, foriine roro damaŋineji wareru fukeme oo gionoŋunde furi bofukekimiŋ.

Ore eru moreŋgo gokimiŋ ore so noŋuŋ ŋiŋigo fiine eyarekimiŋ ore miine dimaku goinebeneŋ. Maŋkekerisie kufufuŋ maŋineo gogobi, oi rone ogo babapi eyareru goinebeneŋ eru yoŋore ŋadiyaŋuŋgo ŋiŋigo goine sosowo kadi fukeko bobiaŋ yaberu goinebeneŋ.
Siŋaŋ bobo eru momojo buŋo tatariine
Pol nonji kirifi roru nakene meji quraŋ qoruine soguine yo ŋoŋore quraŋgago, oi ŋoneniŋ.

Ŋiŋigo Anuture moge sakiŋaŋuŋgo ketiganimiŋ ore bapakare ŋabeegobi, yoŋoji sosowo saki babi moreŋ ŋiŋigoji yoŋore manebi ropeiŋ ore yameŋ keegobi. Kristoji maripoŋgo komeya, buŋo ore kekesuesue egu eŋarenimiŋgo oŋu bapakare ŋabeegobi. Ore fuŋine furuine mo mata.

Anuture mogeyaŋuŋke yoŋoji yoŋoyaŋekoŋ oŋuakoŋ Kadi buŋo so boyobe foreru gogobi. Oŋu matayoŋ, ŋoŋore saki ketiganimiŋgo manegobi, yoŋoji ŋoŋore saki tifeŋaŋunde ore eru yoŋoyaŋunde sakiyaŋuŋ ba ropeku biŋeroroyaŋuŋke fukenimiŋgo maneegobi.

Oŋu maneegobiyoŋ, nonji Ofoŋnoŋuŋ Yesu Kristo maripoŋgo komeya, Biŋe ore eru sakine miteŋ gaego. Tinabiŋe furuine mo so baaego. Oi boke (use)! Kristoji maripoŋgo komeko iŋoke jikigabe mamane buruneji qopieko mosi sembenere misombeŋ baego. Moreŋ ŋiŋigoji sakire eebobo sembene banimiŋ ore manesuku buŋo miegobi, nonji oŋu oobe komekiine kamasi fukego. Miteŋ nunimiŋ me sakineo buŋo ruanimiŋ, ore tifeine oi so bokiriebemiŋ. Moreŋgo buŋo osoeru goine manebi ropeko goine manebi wakiqoqoine fukega, oi nonde mamane buruneke so moakoŋ so fukegobire.
Sakinoŋuŋgo moge ketigabi me mata, oiji so moakoŋ fukega. Oiji abutaine fukegayoŋ, fufuke gariinere kuguŋ fukegobeneŋ, oiji foriine yobu fukega.
Ŋiŋigo fufuke gariinere mimiti buŋo boyoberu gogobi, Anutuji Juda sosowo oi eru Anuture maŋkekerisie kufufuŋ sosowo ŋoŋo ŋonemaiŋ ŋareme womoo goinebi.
Buŋo tatariine oi iŋi migo: Nonji Yesu qabunde ropu oi nake sakineo eko osigaego ore eru moji maŋyobiŋ so jikigaru nareine.
O maŋkekerisie ogopune, Ofoŋnoŋuŋ Yesu Kristore yauŋmoririji ŋoŋoke peku iiruŋaŋuŋ mifiagaine. Buŋo oi foriine.
